title: Repair release freeze published projection boundary
outOfScope: Do not alter, recreate, delete, or relabel immutable v0.5.50 through v0.5.56 tags, Releases, or assets.
Do not lower coverage, test count, or release/installer/security gates.

sources.reason: The unconditional release.json mutation is the confirmed source of hosted lifecycle shard failure.
Hosted failure artifact identifies test_published_projection_is_not_promoted_in_repository as the regression witness.
Hosted lifecycle shard evidence: release.json archive digest changed from published v0.5.56 asset digest to pre-merge candidate archive digest.

riskAssessment.reason: A pre-merge generator incorrectly rewrites immutable published projection fields, risking both false release metadata and blocked hosted shard aggregation.

reasons: Release metadata correction requires strict verification.

override.reason: User authorized complete corrective release work without gate bypass.
notRunChecks: Provider release and public adopter proof remain deferred until the successor PR is merged.

executionDecision.reason: Hosted artifact identifies a deterministic generator defect and the user authorized complete corrective delivery.

preReviewWarnings: Verify a pre-merge freeze never changes the archived/published release.json archive digest, while runtime release materialization remains source-bound.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Pre-merge freeze preserves release.json releaseTag, releaseArchive.sha256, installerDigest, and published metadata digest for the already-published release.
Pre-merge freeze still binds candidate source/tree/archive facts only through release-freeze.json and release-digests.json without promoting candidate bytes into the published projection.
A focused regression test fails against the current unconditional mutation and passes after the minimal fix; hosted lifecycle shard is rerun on the successor PR.
No immutable release, test set, coverage floor, release gate, or failure evidence is weakened.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The v0.5.57 predecessor PR's pre-merge freeze rewrote the current published v0.5.56 release archive digest to the candidate worktree archive digest. Hosted lifecycle shard test_published_projection_is_not_promoted_in_repository correctly failed.
constraints: Preserve immutable historical releases and published projection truth.
Use a fresh Work Item from origin/main; do not revive archived unmerged PR #798.
Keep candidate binding in candidate/freeze evidence, not published release.json.
intent.rationale: Published release metadata is an immutable-provider projection and must not be mutated by candidate pre-merge finalization; separating these namespaces removes the recurrence at the source.

rawUserRequest: 完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。目标是把收益交付给未来安装的 adopter。

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a regression test that invokes premerge finalization in an isolated repository fixture.
